title: Can I Eat Imitation Crab Meat RAW? [Safe Eating Tips]

content.html:
Imitation crab has established its place among renowned dishes in a majority of countries. These include the United States, France, Japan, Spain, Italy, and many others. Americans took inspiration from the Japanese recipe ‘surimi’ and later introduced it in that region. 

Those who just have been introduced to this faux dish and many interested individuals might have several queries in their minds.

One of the top concerns is whether people can enjoy imitation crab without cooking or not. This post clears this confusion along with certain instructions to avoid health issues.

Surimi Imitation crab producers cook the faux crab with hot steam and use boiling water to pasteurize packages to provide safe enjoyable human consumption right out of the package. 

An important thing to note is that you will have to use the crab instantaneously after removing it from the packaging.

Furthermore, one should keep it frozen and only take it out for meals when required. The reason behind this is that it becomes risky to eat at room temperature. Prevention is better than cure, right? 

Safe Consumption Guidelines

Some of the readers might have become anxious after seeing this title. However, there is no need to feel like this since you are about to learn about some aspects one should take care of while dealing with the imitation crab. It will help you take precautions before any mishap occurs.

  • Bacterial Infection
    If you have bought the imitation crab which was previously taken out from the deep freezer, there are high chances that you are prone to bacterial infection. Bacterial genera like Salmonella are responsible for causing health issues. Thus, it is necessary to check the packaging before bringing it home.
  • Not Suitable In Gluten Intolerance
    Mostly the packets of imitation crab have the main ingredients mentioned on them. Many companies put gluten in this meat item.

    It can be problematic for those who have difficulty digesting gluten products. I highly recommend going through the list on the packet before buying the food.
  • Effect On People With Allergy
    In case your body cannot tolerate shellfish meat, the imitation crab is not for you. It is necessary to read the disclaimer on storage boxes that mention the presence of shellfish.

    Consuming these faux crabs can be extremely dangerous and result in severe reactions including anaphylactic shock. There, there. You can enjoy other seafood if you cannot have this faux crab.

Frequently Asked Questions

  • When can babies eat imitation crab?
    Babies can eat imitation crab if they are three or four years old. However, one should not feed this food frequently to babies and toddlers as certain elements such as mercury, high level of sodium, and artificial flavors can harm them. Whenever you purchase imitation crab, get it from a popular and trusted source.
  • Are imitation crab sticks keto?
    Crab sticks, which are made from imitation crab meat, contain several additives and are processed many times. It means one cannot consider them while thinking about shifting to a keto diet plan.
  • Are imitation crab sticks cooked?
    Yes, every imitation crab recipe is cooked and made available for eating before selling. If you do not prefer eating cold meat, you can simply microwave the crab for about 30 seconds or steam it.

How Is Imitation Crab Made?

Imitation crab has about 2% of meat extracted from king crab or shellfish. In addition, it contains both original and artificial traces of lobster and crab. It indicates that this food item is not completely made of crab, hence named imitation crab.

Moreover, it includes a special white fish, surimi. Chefs shape it to make its appearance similar to a spider crab.

Usually, the portions of these ingredients vary from one region to another. Nowadays, it is common to utilize Alaskan pollock in making imitation crab recipes.

Other major contents that manufacturers use include some starch (corn, potato, or wheat), water, sugar, and sorbitol (sweetening and freezing agents).

Protein, mostly egg white, enhances the overall feel, while the addition of salt helps the formation of a gel. Lastly, vegetable oil such as sunflower or soybean is poured.

All these materials facilitate the development of a proper texture, taste, aroma, shelf life, and color.

3 Health Benefits Of Eating Imitation Crab

  1. Enriched With Nutrients
    Imitation crab contains several macronutrients in addition to micronutrients that are essential for the proper functioning of our body parts and mental health.

    As it contains surimi flesh which has a high degree of beneficial components, it also becomes valuable meat. Phosphorus and calcium present in this item are crucial for keeping the bones and teeth strong. The kidney also requires these elements to carry out the filtration effectively.

    Furthermore, they regulate the work of the nervous system and maintain a normal heartbeat. A human body’s daily requirement of phosphorus is 70mg, which one can fulfill by consuming only two ounces of this crab. Sounds awesome﹗
  2. Low In Fats And Calories
    In case you are interested in maintaining your weight or are about to start a weight-loss journey, imitation crab is one of the best diets to incorporate into the list.

    This seafood is extremely beneficial since it has good quality fats that improve the blood flow in arteries and prevent clogging. If you eat three ounces of this crab’s meat, you are intaking 81 calories, about 1 g of fatty acids, and only 17 mg of cholesterol.
  3. Contains Omega-Three Fat
    As every cuisine is made from sea animals rich in omega fatty acids, the imitation crab also contains a major supply of this nutrient.

    Omega fatty acids are necessary for normal brain development, working as well as coordination with nerves.

Final Thoughts

The imitation crab has been in the market for decades, and thousands of people are fond of its taste. Fortunately, families can have these crabs without the requirement of cooking or boiling.

Although it is among the food items that are highly sold and everyone is eager to experience it, one should not forget to take precautions before eating it. Here’s hoping you keep all the factors in mind.
